simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU C3503/C3507 family (chips/c3503.py, matched by bootloader "M3507---3", chip ID 0x3507 at 0xB8000000 and 0xB8080000 -> SDK chip code 0x10056, run_dump_gtmedia_v9_prime_v169_app_starts.py): the XIP bootloader ("M3507---3", 2021-04-09) starts at 0xAFC00000 with CacheAsRam at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF, relocates to 0x82800000, unpacks the 14.53 MB maincode ("1.1.0" at 0x1B0000) to 0x80100200 (CP0 EBase 0x80102000), initialises NIM_S3501H_0 at 0xB804C000, and renders its 1280x720 32-bpp ARGB8888 OSD on GMA layer 0.

desc: GTMedia V9 Prime official firmware V169 (2021-10-13) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the Full HD H.265/HEVC 10-bit DVB-S2X satellite receiver on the single-CPU ALi M3507 / C3507 SoC with 64 MB DDR2.

Unpacks a 14.53 MB single-CPU application (`maincode` "1.1.0" at 0x1B0000) to 0x80100200 and drives the C3507's 128-line interrupt controller at 0xB8081080 / 0xB8081040 and internal S3501H DVB-S2X demodulator at 0xB804C000.
